Aditi Mercer
aditi.mercer@example.com | Albuquerque, NM
SUMMARY
Senior backend engineer with 8 years of experience building backend systems on Distributed systems,
PostgreSQL, REST API design.

- Built and maintained REST APIs in TypeScript serving 75K requests/day.
- Designed a AWS-backed data layer that cut p99 query latency by 62%.
Backend Engineer - Ashgrove Solutions (2023-2024)

- Owned the Kafka event pipeline processing 42M events/day.
Software Engineer I - Bedrock Digital (2018-2023)

- Built and maintained REST APIs in gRPC serving 354K requests/day.
